stories.title: Qayladhaanta Siyaasadeed ee Xildhibaan Taakilo iyo Cabdirisaaq Xagaa
stories.description: Garoowe (Faallo PP) — Xildhibaan Yaasiin Jaamac Cumar (Taakilo) wuxuu aamminsan yahay in Puntland hoggaamiyaheedu sababay in maamul goboleedkii ugu horreeyay… Sii akhri
stories.excerpt: Garoowe (Faallo PP) — Xildhibaan Yaasiin Jaamac Cumar (Taakilo) wuxuu aamminsan yahay in Puntland hoggaamiyaheedu sababay in maamul goboleedkii ugu horreeyay Soomaaliya noqday maamul aan saamayn siyaasadeed lahayn. Wuxuu ugu baaqay Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni in dadka Puntland loo sheego “haddii siyaasadda nalagaga adkaaday; siyaasadda waa lagu kala adkaan jiray.” Taakilo hadalkiisa niyadjabku ka muuqdo wuu ka afeeftay markuu sheegtay in muddo lixdan sano ah ay dadka Puntland Soomaaliya u keenayeen barnaamij lagana aqbali jiray. Puntland faanka siyaasadeed ayaa ka weyn run isu sheegga waayo waa maamul madax-ka-nool ah. Taariikh been ma noqoto xanuun-jebiye siyaasadeed. Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni waxaa la haray la-taliyayaal aan waxba kala soconin siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Sanadkii 2022 wuxuu u tartamay inuu noqdo Madaxweyne xilli qeyb badan oo dhulka Puntland ka mid ahaa uu ku jiray gacanta maamulka goosashodoonka xaruntiisu tahay Hargeysa. Madaxweyne Deni xiriirka wadashaq
stories.imageCaption: Xildhibaan Yaasiin Taakilo: “Ha naloo sheego haddii siyaasadda nalagaga adkaaday; siyaasadda waa lagu kala adkaan jiray.” | Cabdirisaaq Xagaa: “Shabeellada Hoose, Banaadir, Shabeellada Dhexe, Baay iyo Bakool baa jaangoyn doona Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya soddonka sano oo socda.”

stories.excerpt: Mareykanka oo Saldhigaan daganaa mudo dheer ayaa ka laa laabtay qalabkooda. Ciidamada Soomaaliya ayaa lasugayaa inay amaanka dalka lawareegaan. Tani ayaa imaaneysa xili Madaxweynaha waqtigiisa dhamaaday ee Xasan Sheekh uu Codsaday inay sii joogaan Ciidamada shisheeya isaga oo quus ka muujinaya in Ciidamada Soomaaliya anay kufilneyn amaanka. Mareykanka ayaa ka joojiyay dhaqaalahii tirada badnaa ee amaanka Soomaaliya lagu bixin jiray sidoo kale Ciidamada shisheeye ee ay Uganda ugu horeysa ayaa iyagana ka baxay dalka. Arrimahaan oo dhan ayaa waxaay imaadeen xili arrimaha gudaha dalka ay cakiran yihiin Sida hiiraan , Puntland, Jubaland iyo koonfur galbeed iyada oo Xasan Sheekh uu kuhowlan yahay qabyaalada iyo kala qoqobka dalka. Waxaa taasi sii dheer dhaca iyo boobka hantida dadweynaha ee gobolka Banaadir oo wali socda.

Fulinta xukunnadan ayaa timid kaddib markii Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu saxeexay amarka lagu meelmarinayo xukunnada dilka ah ee ay maxkamaduhu hore u soo saareen. stories.title: Ilhaan Cumar oo qareenno caan ah u qabsatay baaritaannada federaalka ee ku socda
stories.description: Arbaco, November 11, 2026 (HOL) – Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar oo laga soo doorto gobolka Minnesota ayaa dib ugu laabatay xarunta Congress-ka Mareykanka, iyadoo ay wehliyaan laba qareen oo caan ah, xilli ay wajahdo baaritaanno federaal ah oo la xiriira xaaladdeeda socdaal iyo xogaha ay hore uga gudbisay dhaqaalaha.
stories.excerpt: Arbaco, November 11, 2026 (HOL) – Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar oo laga soo doorto gobolka Minnesota ayaa dib ugu laabatay xarunta Congress-ka Mareykanka, iyadoo ay wehliyaan laba qareen oo caan ah, xilli ay wajahdo baaritaanno federaal ah oo la xiriira xaaladdeeda socdaal iyo xogaha ay hore uga gudbisay dhaqaalaha. Warbaahinta Fox News ayaa sheegtay in labada qareen, Amy Jeffress iyo Joshua Matz, oo ka tirsan shirkadda sharciga ee Heckler Fink LLP, laga arkay iyagoo Talaadadii ka baxaya xafiiska Ilhaan Cumar ee magaalada Washington, kaddib kulan qaatay ku dhowaad laba saacadood. Qareennadan ayaa la sheegay inay u qaabilsan yihiin difaaca xildhibaanka, iyadoo ay socdaan baaritaanno ay wadaan hay'ado federaal ah oo Mareykanka ka tirsan. Labada qareen kama aysan jawaabin su'aalo ay weriyeyaashu ka weydiiyeen kalsoonida ay ku qabaan difaaca ay u diyaariyeen Ilhaan Cumar. Baaritaannada ayaa waxaa ka mid ah mid la xiriira dukumentiyadii ay Ilhaan Cumar ku buuxisay codsigeedii socdaalka Mareykanka

stories.description: Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa magaalada Jeddah ku kala saxiixday heshiiska qoondada Xajka ee sannadka 1448 Hijriyada, kuna beegan 2027-ka, kaas oo Soomaaliya loogu qoondeeyay 11,500 oo muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ah oo fursad u heli doona gudashada waajibaadka Xajka.
stories.excerpt: Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa magaalada Jeddah ku kala saxiixday heshiiska qoondada Xajka ee sannadka 1448 Hijriyada, kuna beegan 2027-ka, kaas oo Soomaaliya loogu qoondeeyay 11,500 oo muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ah oo fursad u heli doona gudashada waajibaadka Xajka. Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa magaalada Jeddah ku kala saxiixday heshiiska qoondada Xajka ee sannadka 1448 Hijriyada, kuna beegan 2027-ka, kaas oo Soomaaliya loogu qoondeeyay 11,500 oo muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ah oo fursad u heli doona gudashada waajibaadka Xajka. Heshiiska waxaa kala saxiixday Wasiirka Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, iyo Wasiirka Xajka iyo Cumrada ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, Dr. Towfiiq bin Fowzaan Al-Rabiici. Heshiiskan oo sannad kasta ay labada dowladood wada galaan ayaa qeexaya tirada xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee loo oggolaanayo inay sannadka soo socda tagaan dhulka barakey

stories.excerpt: Ururka Qareennada dalalka Bariga Afrika ee magacooda loo soo gaabiyo EALS ayaa madaxweynaha dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud u soo jeediyay in uu ixtiraamto go’aannada Maxkamadda Sare. Qareennada Bariga Afrika waxay ku eedeeyeen madaxweyne Xasan Shekh Maxamuud in uu qaaday tallaabooyin halis gelinaya madaxbannaanida garsoorka, iyaga oo xusay in ilaaladii laga qaaday guddoomiye Baashe, loona hanjabay garsoorayaal. Sidoo kale Maxkamadda Sare waxay fartay dhinacyada ay qusayso doorashada in ay muddo 30 berri gudahood ah ku gaaraan heshiis wadar ogol ah, islamarkaana ay 90 berri gudahood ku qabtaan doorashada. Maxkamadda Sare waxay sharci darro ku tilmaantay go’aankii uu madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh xilka uga qaaday guddoomiye Baashe Yuusuf Axmed.

Uno puede enfadarse mucho por ello y no cambiar nada. ¿Si a veces tuve que apretar el puño en el bolsillo? ¿Si tuve que maldecir sin que nadie me oyera? ¡Por supuesto!", afirma. stories.title: Meet the youngest top-flight manager in Europe
stories.description: As football has evolved, so have routes into football management.
stories.excerpt: Jordan Hadaway has been in charge of Llandudno since August 2023; at 18, he was managing Caerwys and a 41-year-old captain; now 25, he has a UEFA A Licence and took the Seasiders back to the Cymru Premier with promotion in 2025/26 As football has evolved, so have routes into football management. Once almost exclusively the preserve of former professionals, a playing career is no longer a prerequisite. That has opened the door to the younger generation. Thirteen managers and head coaches in England's top four divisions are under 40, with Brighton's Fabian Hurzeler the youngest at 33. But the Cymru Premier - formerly known as the Welsh Premier League - is home to the youngest top-flight manager in Europe. Last season, Jordan Hadaway guided Llandudno to promotion from the Cymru North. In July, he turned the grand old age of 25. stories.excerpt: The German government says its military will stop using Chinese-made drones for training purposes and replace them with German or other European models BERLIN -- The German military will stop using Chinese-made drones for training purposes and replace them with German or other European models, the government said Wednesday. The Defense Ministry said that commanders in the German military, the Bundeswehr, can buy off-the-shelf commercial drones for training and some exercise purposes. It stressed that such drones can only be used after a risk assessment and in circumstances where no “security-relevant information" is at risk. It said in an emailed statement that “in order to strengthen the Bundeswehr's self-sufficiency and technological sovereignty,” no Chinese drone models will be used in the future, and they will be replaced by domestic or other European-made drones. Khan, 74, briefly left the Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi for an eye examination at Islamabad’s Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), the government hospital said on Wednesday. stories.excerpt: House Republicans blocked an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Tuesday, providing a reprieve for the Pentagon chief before Democrats take control of Congress next year. The vote on a procedural motion came hours after Hegseth denounced efforts to impeach him as a farce and defended his record at the helm of the U.S. military, winning praise from President Donald Trump. The House voted 211 to 204 in favor of a motion to refer eight articles of impeachment to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee, a move that U.S. Representative Thomas Massie, the sponsor of the impeachment push, warned would kill the effort. Massie, an outgoing Kentucky Republican, had hoped to draw votes from Republicans upset with Hegseth's policies and wary of the unpopularity of the eight-month Iran war, but no other Republicans joined him. The U.S.-Israeli-led conflict has never been approved by Congress, which is the only branch of government constitutionally permitted to declare war. Democra

The country recorded nine Ebola cases in October after the first patient traveled from Congo through Uganda, transmitting the virus to four family members and four healthcare workers. stories.title: ‘No babies, no toddlers’: The Virginia island where land and people are disappearing
stories.description: Every year, Tangier Island loses ground the sea and people to old age or easier lives on shore. Those who are left are searching for ways to save their historic town.
stories.excerpt: When Gil Pruitt was growing up on the shrinking island of Tangier, winters were much colder than today, with ice sometimes covering the bay. Children on the West Ridge, a slightly elevated filament of land on the island’s western side, would walk to school together in packs to make the cold easier to bear. Gil would wait until the kids who lived a bit farther down the road walked by, and then rush out to shelter among them. “As a smaller kid, you’d walk behind the tall kids, to let them block the wind, because the school was on the other end of the island,” recalled Pruitt, who traces his ancestry back to some of Tangier’s early settlers in the early 1800s. In 1960, the year Pruitt was born, the Census counted 876 people living on Tangier, an isolated offshore island known for its devout religiosity and, more recently, its flooding, sinking land. US military archives call the Korean War “The Forgotten War,” though some 1.8 million Americans served during its three years – and more than 36,500 of them died, along with at least 200,000 South Korean, 400,000 North Korean and 600,000 Chinese troops. But Finn, who fought in one of the war’s bloodiest battles, has never forgotten the Marine from Center Point, Iowa, who saved his life twice. He will carry his name back home to Minnesota. stories.excerpt: On November 11, 1918, World War I came to an end after Germany and the Allied Powers signed an armistice, bringing four years of devastating fighting to a halt and drawing a close to one of the deadliest conflicts in modern history. The armistice was signed at 5am in a railway carriage in the Forest of Compiègne, France, and took effect at 11am. The moment became known as the 11th hour of the 11th day of the 11th month, a date subsequently commemorated as Armistice Day in honour of those who died during the war. Uganda, then under British colonial administration, was part of the wider African contribution to the war, particularly through the East African Campaign, where Allied forces fought German colonial troops in German East Africa, present-day Tanzania. Gunmen had killed 26 people in Pahalgam in India-administered Kashmir that April. stories.excerpt: Booming exports mask a thriftiness among the Chinese that could undermine long-term growth. China’s $1.04 trillion trade surplus in the first 10 months of the year is a testament to its mighty export engine. It is also a sign of structural weaknesses that, left unchecked, threaten to derail China’s bid to join the ranks of the wealthiest nations. While its status as the world’s factory helped it achieve a dramatic rise in living standards beginning in the late 1970s, China’s export-led economic model is facing diminishing returns. Even as the AI boom drives its exports to record highs, the world’s second-largest economy suffers from chronically weak domestic demand. Chinese consumers save far more than their peers elsewhere, with households typically putting away one-third or more of earnings. Named the Anabasis Northern Route, the itinerary forms the third stage of the "Route of Ancient Cities" project developed by the Turkish Tourism Promotion and Development Agency (TGA). US Africa Command deputy head Lt Gen John Brennan said Madagascar's strategic location in the Indian Ocean made it important to global trade. He warned against what he called the "Sahel model", which he said risked fuelling instability across the continent. Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, all under military rule, have severed ties with the Western partners and turned to Russia to military support their fight against jihadist groups. Russia has expanded its military cooperation with Madagascar since the military seized power in 2025, supplying weapons and military instructors. stories.excerpt: Du lancement à Tokyo de son livre en version japonaise aux cérémonies de mémoire de Minamisoma , en passant par une série de rencontres consacrées au climat, l’ancien ambassadeur de Djibouti au Japon a effectué, du 24 octobre au 5 novembre 2026, une visite qui confirme la place singulière qu’occupe la République de Djibouti dans le cœur de nombreux Japonais. TOKYO — Il est des diplomates qui quittent leur poste et tournent la page. Et il y a ceux dont la présence continue de compter longtemps après leur départ. S.E. Ahmed Araïta Ali appartient à la seconde catégorie. Pendant près de deux semaines, l’ancien ambassadeur de Djibouti au Japon a retrouvé un pays où il a vécu treize ans avec sa famille, et où il a laissé un réseau d’amitiés que le temps n’a pas défait. Le prétexte de ce retour était littéraire : le lancement de la version japonaise de son livre, Mes années au Soleil levant à l’ombre du drapeau de Djibouti. L’ouvrage retrace l’expérience d’un homme qui a fait de la diplomatie

stories.excerpt: De l’instabilité des années 1990 aux perspectives prometteuses de 2030, la République de Djibouti affiche une transformation économique majeure, portée par des investissements stratégiques, une résilience remarquable et une ambition affirmée de développement durable. La trajectoire économique de la République de Djibouti témoigne d’une évolution spectaculaire au cours des dernières décennies. Notre pays est progressivement passé d’une période de fortes turbulences économiques à une dynamique de croissance soutenue, atteignant certaines années des niveaux proches de 7% à 7,5%. Cette progression illustre la capacité de Djibouti à transformer ses atouts géographiques en véritables leviers de développement. Dans les années 1990, l’économie djiboutienne traversait une période difficile, marquée par des contractions importantes et de fortes fluctuations de croissance. Pourtant, à partir des années 2000, une nouvelle dynamique s’est installée, soutenue par la modernisation des infrastructures

rejected.excerpt: Addis Ababa, November 11, 2026 (FMC) – Regional security developments and the importance of sustained dialogue in advancing peace and stability were at the centre of discussions between Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud ahead of the COP31 Leaders’ Summit in Antalya, Türkiye. The meeting provided an opportunity for the two leaders to exchange views on the prevailing security situation in Somalia and wider developments across the region. In a social media post following the engagement, Prime Minister Abiy emphasized the importance of continued dialogue and cooperation in addressing regional challenges and advancing shared interests in peace and stability. The meeting underscores the significance of sustained engagement between Ethiopia and Somalia on matters of regional security, with developments in Somalia and the wider Horn of Africa carrying implications for the region’s peace and stability.
